title: BOXES SEARCH FASTER TOGETHER
why: His decision 10-28: Crates open faster with two. Every searchable box gains 1.5 times search speed while another live party member stands within 200 units, in demo and career co-op. The host search, host handling of a partner hold and partner bar use the same helper. Solo speed and seeded generation stay unchanged. Playtest watch: two players may stack on every box; watch that searching alone does not start to feel slow.
now: Boxes search 1.5 times faster with a nearby teammate.

edits.anchor: near.prog=(near.prog||0)+dt/buzzSlow()*(G.arcade?ARCADE_SRCH:1);   // v23.33 (arcade11): six times as fast in the arcade
edits.replacement: near.prog=(near.prog||0)+dt/buzzSlow()*(G.arcade?ARCADE_SRCH:1)*(duoAt(near,NET.seat)?DUO_SRCH:1);   // v28.xx (cw-cx-duosearch): a nearby party member helps the host search
if(s.ok) near.prog=Math.min(near.time||1,(near.prog||0)+dt/buzzSlow()*(G.arcade?ARCADE_SRCH:1)*(duoAt(near,NET.seat)?DUO_SRCH:1));   // v28.xx (cw-cx-duosearch): predict the same speed as the host

edits.anchor: ct.prog=(ct.prog||0)+dt/r.slow*(G.arcade?ARCADE_SRCH:1);   // v23.33 (arcade11): a box held through the host is fast in the arcade too
edits.replacement: ct.prog=(ct.prog||0)+dt/r.slow*(G.arcade?ARCADE_SRCH:1)*(duoAt(ct,+s)?DUO_SRCH:1);   // v28.xx (cw-cx-duosearch): the host himself can help a partner search
